text:
Puto is the man that of putas fía,

and puto the that his gustos apetece;

puto is the estipendio that itself ofrece

in pago of his puta compañía.


Puto is the gusto, and puta the joy

that the rato putaril nos encarece;

and I diré that is puto a quien parece

that no sois puta vos, señora mía.


Mas llámenme a mí puto enamorado,

if al cabo for puta no os dejare;

and as puto muera I quemado


if of otras tales putas me pagare,

because the putas graves are costosas,

and the putillas viles, afrentosas.

translation.title: Desengaño of the mujeres
